editorial:
Imagine discovering you have magic powers and a missing mother who was snatched by dark forces. That is exactly what you get with this charming story. You will follow Ruby, a spirited young witch who refuses to give up on her family. The vibe is lighthearted and colorful, making it feel like a magical adventure that does not take itself too seriously. It is the kind of movie that makes you feel like a kid again, exploring a world where anything is possible if you just believe in your spells.

You will love how the magic looks on screen and the way Ruby grows as a character. While the plot is pretty straightforward, the energy stays high and the acting is sweet. One small downside is that some parts feel a bit rushed, but the heart of the story makes up for it. If you are looking for a cozy night in, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for family movie nights.
endingExplained: After a big magical battle, Ruby uses all her strength and courage to defeat the evil forces holding her mother captive. She manages to break the dark spell and finally reunites with her mom in a very emotional scene. The movie wraps up with Ruby accepting her role as a powerful witch and promising to protect her family. It ends on a happy note, showing that love is the strongest magic of all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and heartwarming family stories.
